name: Block Animate
description: Adds Animate.css entrance/exit animations to blocks via the block configuration form (block third-party settings).
project_description: Block Animate integrates the Animate.css cross-browser CSS animation library with Drupal blocks. It bundles animate.min.css and adds an "Animate CSS" fieldset to every block's configuration form (Structure > Block layout), letting a site builder choose one of ~70 named animations (fadeIn, bounceIn, slideInLeft, zoomOut, etc.) plus an optional infinite-loop toggle. The chosen animation is stored as a block third-party setting and applied as animate__animated animate__<effect> classes when the block renders. No external CDN request, no routes, no permissions, no settings page.
